cedric.name: Sir Cedric
cedric.description: A middle aged knight, strong and confident baritone, slightly gruff, British accent, speaks with urgency and courage.

aldren.name: King Aldren
aldren.description: An older man in his sixties, a wise medieval king. Deep, regal, warm and calm voice with a gentle British accent, slow and dignified.

elian.name: Elian
elian.description: An adult man, royal herald, clear projecting tenor voice, cheerful and formal, British accent.

brom.name: Brom
brom.description: A burly adult blacksmith, deep rough bass voice, friendly and blunt, northern English accent.

iris.name: Iris
iris.description: An adult woman alchemist, soft curious mezzo voice, thoughtful and a little mysterious, British accent.

vera.name: Vera
vera.description: An adult woman armorer in her forties, firm and practical alto voice, confident, Scottish accent.

alma.name: Sister Alma
alma.description: An older woman priestess, serene gentle and kind voice, slow and soothing, British accent.

roan.name: Roan
roan.description: An adult male town guard, stern steady voice, disciplined and direct, English accent.

bruno.name: Bruno
bruno.description: A jolly adult innkeeper, warm hearty baritone with a laugh in it, welcoming, English accent.

nox-alchemist.name: Mirael
nox-alchemist.description: An adult female elf alchemist, airy whispering mezzo voice, calm and otherworldly, elegant accent.

nox-armorer.name: Zynrae
nox-armorer.description: An adult female dark elf armor master, sharp proud alto voice, precise and cool, elegant accent.

nox-smith.name: Theryn
nox-smith.description: An adult male dark elf weaponsmith, low cold smooth voice, quiet intensity, elegant accent.

nox-priestess.name: Ilyra
nox-priestess.description: An adult female elf moon priestess, soft ethereal and serene voice, slow and melodic, elegant accent.

nox-mycologist.name: Sael
nox-mycologist.description: An adult male elf gardener, gentle warm low voice, patient and kind, elegant accent.

nox-merchant.name: Nym
nox-merchant.description: An adult male elf merchant, sly silky voice, hushed and conspiratorial, elegant accent.

nox-sentinel.name: Veyra
nox-sentinel.description: An adult female dark elf sentinel, firm watchful low voice, solemn and proud, elegant accent.
